senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. סָלַד)to swing, be light; to bound. Ab. d’R. N. 2ⁿᵈ vers., ch. XXX (ed. Schechter, p. לב) אם יעלה … היא סוֹלֶלֶת אחריה if you take an animal to the top of a roof, it will start backward (be afraid).—Part. pass. סָלוּל; pl. סְלוּלִין swinging, high. Y. Maasr. V, end, 52ᵃ (expl. זרע לוף העליון, ib. V, 8) זרע הס׳ של לוף R. S. to Maasr. l. c. (ed. הסיליון) the seed in the swinging tops of lof (Maim. העֶלְיוֹן).
to rebound. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵇ, v. עָגַל.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:7">Tosef. Sot. V, 7</cite> <he>המְסַלֶּלֶת בבנה קטן</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>המְסַלְסֶלֶת</he>, Var. <he>המסולס׳</he>) a woman that commits lewdness with her little son; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 69b:5">Snh. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>המְסוֹלֶלֶת</he> (Ms. K. <he>המסלסלת</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300); Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ bot. <he>המְסַלֶּדֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 76a:8">Yeb. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>נשים המְסוֹלְלוֹת זו בזו</he> women that commit lewdness with one another; <cite ref="Shabbat 65a">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite>; Y. l. c. <he>המְסַלְּדוֹת</he>.—V. <cite ref="O01011"><he>סִלְסֵל</he></cite>.
